operations.undo: active history unchanged; checkpoint stores content, not undo history
document replacement invalidates prior handles and history; recovered content is dirty

swap.description: Allow native swapping when an exact destination key exists; default false.

easing.description: Native interpolation for the segment starting at this key: 0=linear, 1=inquad, 2=outquad, 3=inoutquad, 4=outinquad, 5=incubic, 6=outcubic, 7=inoutcubic, 8=outincubic, 9=inquart, 10=outquart, 11=inoutquart, 12=outinquart, 13=inquint, 14=outquint, 15=inoutquint, 16=outinquint, 17=insine, 18=outsine, 19=inoutsine, 20=outinsine, 21=inexpo, 22=outexpo, 23=inoutexpo, 24=outinexpo, 25=incirc, 26=outcirc, 27=inoutcirc, 28=outincirc, 29=inelastic, 30=outelastic, 31=inoutelastic, 32=outinelastic, 33=inback, 34=outback, 35=inoutback, 36=outinback, 37=inbounce, 38=outbounce, 39=inoutbounce, 40=outinbounce.

field.description: 0=reset transform, 1=reset translation, 2=reset scale, 3=reset rotation, 4=align next key horizontally, 5=align next key vertically, 6=hold transform at next key. Alignment/hold require a following key.
